name: Ontario: income and sales tax, 2026
name_fr: Ontario : impôt sur le revenu et taxes de vente, 2026
description: Provincial/territorial personal income tax brackets, basic personal amount and sales tax rates for Ontario for the 2026 tax year, with estimated take-home pay for a single employee at three salaries.

attributes.surtax: Ontario surtax: 20% of basic Ontario tax above $5,818 plus 36% above $7,446
attributes.health_premium: Ontario Health Premium on taxable income: $0 to $20,000 nil; maximum $300 / $450 / $600 / $750 / $900 at thresholds $36,000 / $48,000 / $72,000 / $200,000 / above $200,000

sales_tax.note: HST replaces GST and PST in participating provinces. PST/QST bases and exemptions differ from GST and are set provincially; only headline rates are recorded here.

attributes.notes: Ontario surtax: 20% of basic provincial tax above $5,818 plus 36% above $7,446. Ontario Health Premium: $0 up to $20,000 taxable income, rising to a maximum of $900 above about $200,000 (T4127 schedule). Ontario tax reduction applies only at low incomes.

sources.title: Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026) — page modified 2026-06-25

verification.notes: Brackets agree between the CRA current-year page and T4127 Table 8.1 (Jan 2026, PE updated May 2026).

limitations: Headline rates only: no refundable credits, low-income reductions, dividend or capital-gains treatment, or property taxes. The net-pay figures in attributes are estimates (method in nat-ca-take-home-pay-examples-2026), not official figures.
